title: PF-2 v0.4 / one barrel and three removable bonded cells

parts.name: 01_CommonBarrel
parts.role: One enclosing barrel; three independent stepped metal seats and nominal cell locking threads; integral 1 mm stop land.

parts.name: 02_L1_BondedCell
parts.role: L1 individually centered and bonded on bench; own rear shoulder; nominal external thread, body outer cylinder and rear face locate to barrel. Not glass-load stacked.

parts.name: 03_L2_BondedCell
parts.role: L2 individually centered and bonded on bench; own rear shoulder; nominal external thread, body outer cylinder and rear face locate to barrel. Not glass-load stacked.

parts.name: 04_L3_BondedCell
parts.role: L3 individually centered and bonded on bench; own rear shoulder; nominal external thread, body outer cylinder and rear face locate to barrel. Not glass-load stacked.

parts.name: 05_G4G5_Retainer
parts.role: Independent front retainer for G4-G5; nominal M38 envelope only; no preload through bonded lenses

parts.name: 06_Spacer_G4_G5
parts.role: Long downstream spacer; no L1-L2 or L2-L3 spacers

parts.name: 09_RearRetainer
parts.role: Rear stack retainer; nominal thread envelope only

blank_revisions.change: Radius increased from 21.711578596 to 22.3 mm; peripheral flats extended outside original clear apertures only.

assembly_scheme: One common barrel. L1/L2/L3 bonded separately in three removable short cells; each cell has its own barrel shoulder and nominal locking thread. No enlarged v0.3 rims or separate lens retainers.

bench: Insert each lens into its own cell; seat, optically center, bond at 3 locations, cure and recheck
front: L3 bonded cell -> deepest metal seat
L2 bonded cell -> middle metal seat
L1 bonded cell -> front metal seat

warnings: L1/L2 restore original demo blanks; L3 retains only the existing v0.2 OD44.6 rim, not the v0.3 OD48 rim.
Nominal locking thread envelopes only; datum pilots, thread relief and production fits need detailing.
Bond line radial gap 0.08 mm is provisional; no adhesive material or cure stress modeled.
L3 uses three front-open glue windows instead of tiny closed holes. L2 shoulder is 1 mm thick, carrying its own lens only.
Original rear spacer contact not changed; exact glass contact requires review.
Optical stop finite land acceptance not ray traced.

radial_features.kind: Adhesive application and cure access; bond geometry not modeled
Adhesive application and cure access; bond geometry not modeled
